description: challenge yourself and win nft , this project is centered around classic mind games , currently we only have suduku but we plan to add a lot more, all games utilize zk technology to verify the answer and reward nfts, once the particibant collect all the games nft they are able to mint a grand nft to show case how brilliant they are
